_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Report of Shipment (REPSHIP) Data Requirements
summary: This report notifies the domestic customer or transshipping activity clearance authority (OCEAN) or customer service branch (CSB) (AIR) or Continental United States (CONUS) sea terminal of the transportation of arms, ammunition, and explosives (AA&E) and sensitive materiel.
use_relationship:
This report notifies the domestic customer or transshipping activity clearance authority (OCEAN) or customer service branch (CSB) (AIR) or Continental United States (CONUS) sea terminal of the transportation of arms, ammunition, and explosives (AA&E) and sensitive materiel.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract statement of work (SOW).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The REPSHIP shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content:
The REPSHIP shall contain the following data:

From: Shipping Activity
To: Domestic Customer or Transshipping Activity Clearance Authority (OCEAN) or Customer Service Branch (CSB) (AIR) or CONUS sea terminal

Info: Sponsoring Service Accountable Supply Activity Ultimate Consignee/Final Destination
Subject: Report of Shipment (REPSHIP)

children.title: Shipment date
children.content: Shipment date written as a three-digit day of the year (Julian).

children.title: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA)
children.content: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) written as a three-digit day of the year (Julian) (Observe Standard Transit Time (STT) if CONUS truck shipment and no required delivery date (RDD) identified).

children.title: Required Delivery Date (RDD) or Delivery Date (DD)
children.content: Required Delivery Date (RDD) or Delivery Date (DD) if specified.

children.title: Air Release Number
children.content: Air Release Number (See Notes 1, 2, 3) or for Surface Shipments, Export Traffic Release (ETR) Number, Vessel Name, and Voyage Document Number.

children.title: Rounds, pieces, weight, cube, condition code, and lot numbers
children.content: Rounds, pieces, weight, cube, condition code, and lot numbers (See Note 4).

children.title: Security Risk Category (SRC)
children.content: Security Risk Category (SRC), (e.g., Security Risk Category I, II, III, IV, U, Secret, Confidential, None).

children.title: Department of Defense Identification Code/Navy Ammunition Logistic Code (DODIC/NALC)
children.content: Department of Defense Identification Code/Navy Ammunition Logistic Code (DODIC/NALC). (See Note 4).

children.title: Multiple shipment units
children.content: When the conveyance contains more than one shipment unit, repeat the data elements in separately lettered paragraphs for each shipment unit.

children.title: Cargo for more than one vessel or flight
children.content: Cargo for more than one vessel or flight, but shipped to Point of Embarkation (POE) in a single conveyance, is included in a single REPSHIP. When cargo for a single vessel is moved to the Secondary Point of Embarkation (SPOE) in more than one conveyance, repeat all the data elements as above in separate numbered paragraphs for each conveyance or REPSHIP.

children.title: Separate REPSHIP for each mode of shipment
children.content: A separate REPSHIP is used for each mode of shipment to the POE.

children.title: Lot number, DODIC, and NALC
children.content: Lot number, DODIC, and NALC are not mandatory fields. If available, they may be provided in the electronic REPSHIP or in the template above. If a Commercial Bill of Lading (CBL) is used, the lot number and ammunition condition code should be included in the remarks section. Weapons must be identified on the CBL by each serial number contained within the shipment.

children.title: DODIC and NALC
children.content: DODIC and NALC are codes used specifically for logistic administration and control of ammunition.
